title: the account
hook: an anon account posts your school's secrets. today's is one only you and your bff knew.
setting: A small high school in Oregon, the week of homecoming, junior year.
tone: paranoid, smart, a mystery you solve between classes

self.description: Sixteen, trusting, about to stop being.
self.want: To find out who's behind it.
self.avoids: Accusing the one person you can't lose.

cast.name: Grace
cast.description: The only one who knew. Insists it wasn't her.
cast.closeness: best friends since you were six

opening.title: The account
opening.description: Since September, @whispersof_wh has posted a secret a week. No one knows who runs it.

opening.title: The secret
opening.description: Only you and Grace knew you're moving after this year.

opening.title: Lunch
opening.description: At 12:05 the account posts it, with a countdown to your last day.
